quest.title: Adeptus's Gift
quest.description: Zibai has prepared a small gift for you. What could it be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It doesn't look like Zibai's here... And after she invited us to come, too! Where could she have run off to?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh! This parasol looks familiar... Have we seen it somewhere before?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe it belongs to her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're probably right... But why would she leave her parasol here by the door?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She does have a pretty poor memory...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are we going to do? The way things are going, Paimon's worried she'll get halfway through eating and forget how to pick up her chopsticks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* We should go find her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a moment... I'm not sure this is really a parasol.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What is it, then? Hmm... Let Paimon take a closer look...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's going on? How did we end up here?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: So, how do you like the little trinket I made for you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is where you are, Zibai! What's this parasol? It suddenly went "whoosh" and transported us here!

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: It seems I'm not the only one who struggles to remember things. Have you already forgotten riding on it with me before?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Does that jog your memory?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! It's... It's the lunar chariot! No wonder it looked so familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Haha, it's just a replica created from my memories.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: And it's all thanks to the broken jade token you returned to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So this is the little trinket you were planning to make!

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Precisely. This jade-token chariot can quickly transport you wherever you wish to go, which should help your travels unfold more smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Please take it, my dutiful guides.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this is amazing... Paimon thought you were saying all that "making a trinket" stuff to be nice — she never expected you'd actually do it!

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I had expected it to take some time, considering how badly the token was damaged — its spiritual energy was completely gone.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: But fortunately for us, this is Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's so special about it?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Do you know exactly where about we are in the vale?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhm... Yilong Wharf?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Hehe, you have much to learn about this place.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: The ground beneath our feet is actually one of the key intersections in Liyue's Ley Lines. There are eight such nodes in total...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Life, Death, Repose, Concealment, Initiation, Terrain, Fright, and Injury.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: You're more familiar with this place than I expected...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Paimon remembers now. You're talking about the eight gates!

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Correct. Where we stand right now is the center of the most auspicious of those gates — the Gate of Life.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: The Gate of Life symbolizes growth, prosperity, and revitalization. Thus, I was able to replenish the jade token's spiritual energy so quickly and craft this chariot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, talk about a power-packed position! Guess Chenyu Vale really is a land of wonders...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Indeed... You would do well to settle here in peace and prosperity...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Whaddya mean "you"...?

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: It's nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Alright, I have done all I wished to do. You may go about your business.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I plan to take a stroll atop the mountain. This is where we part ways.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you, Zibai.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: No need to thank me. You woke me from my slumber — it is I who am in your debt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was all Zhongli's doing, really.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: And I have told him much the same as I've said to you.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: He mentioned that you're on a long journey...

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Does your next stop happen to be a distant land of snow?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, we're heading to Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Snezhnaya... Hmm, although I know nothing about the place, no journey through ice and snow is without its dangers.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: If you find yourselves in need of help, you know where to find me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I know.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Take care.
